# OneTapCheckIn

OneTapCheckIn helps organizations manage events, attendee profiles, check-ins, passports, integrations, and attendance alerts.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onetapcheckin/.

## Actions

- **Add Participants**: Add one or more existing profiles to one or more lists without checking them in.
- **Create List**: Create an event/check-in list.
- **Create Profile**: Create one person profile without adding it to a list.
- **Create Profiles**: Create 1 to 25 person profiles in input order using one provider request per profile.
- **Delete List**: Permanently delete one list by ID.
- **Delete Profile**: Permanently delete one profile.
- **Find Lists** (read-only): Get one list by exact ID or search the connected organization's lists.
- **Find Participants** (read-only): Get one participant by exact ID or search attendance records by list, profile, status, text, or date range.
- **Find Profiles** (read-only): Get one profile by ID or search profiles by identity, list, passport, or check-in code.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Return the organization associated with the connected API key.
- **Get Profile Custom Fields** (read-only): Return the organization's configured profile custom-field definitions so an agent can use valid field names and value types when creating…
- **List Alerts** (read-only): Return one page of organization alert and automation rules together with outbound check-in confirmation settings.
- **List Passports** (read-only): List one page of standard passports for exactly one profile or participant.
- **Remove Participant**: Remove one participant record from its list.
- **Update List**: Partially update a list.
- **Update Participant**: Update metadata on one participant record without performing check-in or checkout.
- **Update Participant Attendance**: Check in, check out, undo check-in, or undo checkout for one known participant.
- **Update Participant Attendance Batch**: Apply one shared check-in, checkout, undo check-in, or undo checkout operation to 1 to 25 participants in input order, using one provider…
- **Update Profile**: Partially update one profile.
